crossRefs.note: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had…
Today, Yahweh will deliver you into my hand. I will strike you, and take your head from off you. I will give the dead…
You have declared today how you have dealt well with me, because when Yahweh had delivered me up into your hand, you…
Then Abishai said to David, “God has delivered up your enemy into your hand today. Now therefore please let me strike…
God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, Yahweh…
Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on…

translations.web: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
translations.bsb: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
translations.kjv: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
translations.asv: And thou hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; Thou hast set my feet in a large place.
